name: Alanna Dale
source:
On the surface, Alanna Dale is a cheerful and talented bard who frequents Geoffrey's court. But secrets and lies lurk below her playful surface. How far will she go in her fight to better the lives of Nottingham's poor? What side is she really on, and who is she willing to betray?
When she and Marion fall in love despite themselves, they will be drawn into a magical struggle with echoes across the centuries. Does Marion have what it takes to save her love? Does she even want to?

Strengths: Performance, urban survival, charm
Flaws: Secretive, dark side, cursed(?)

Likes: Music, pranks, the overthrow of the ruling class
Dislikes: The rich, the powerful, druids and fae
